subject: English
question_text: Complete the text with suitable prepositions.
stimulus: Internet is the latest discovery of science and the greatest advancement (a) ----- the field of communication. It is the computerized process (b) ----- telephone set. To get internet connection, it requires a modern telephone line and a different sort (c) ----- software (d) ----- using the network system. Like telephone number, internet is maintained (e) ----- its own number.
guide_solution: Use of prepositions: (a) in; (b) of; ( c) of; (d) for; (e) through/by.
